abstractEnglish: We resolve the contact-Fano homogeneity conjecture and the Riemannian LeBrun–Salamon conjecture positively. Every smooth connected complex projective contact Fano manifold of complex dimension at least three, with its given contact distribution, is contact-isomorphic to the adjoint variety of a simple complex Lie algebra. Consequently, every closed connected smooth positive quaternionic-Kähler manifold of real dimension $`4m\geq8`$ is homothetic to a compact symmetric Wolf space.
titleEn: Contact Fano manifolds and the LeBrun–Salamon conjecture

details.overview: 该稿件声称正面解决了接触Fano齐性猜想与Riemannian LeBrun–Salamon猜想。摘要称：每个复维数至少三的光滑连通复射影接触Fano流形，在给定接触分布下，都接触同构于某单复李代数的伴随簇；由此每个实维数4m≥8的闭连通光滑正四元数Kähler流形都位似于紧对称Wolf空间。摘要未给出证明细节。若成立，将统一接触几何与四元数Kähler几何中的两个重要分类问题。需注意这是AI产生的研究手稿，收录不表示已完成独立审查或同行评议。
keyPoints: 稿件声称正面解决接触Fano齐性猜想，复维数至少三的接触Fano流形同构于伴随簇。
由此声称解决Riemannian LeBrun–Salamon猜想，正四元数Kähler流形位似于Wolf空间。
